headline: Team head coach introduces mandatory 20-minute 'Bowling Appreciation Seminar' to ensure players remember the existence of leather balls
body: Following concerns that the current squad has forgotten how to handle anything besides a willow, the technical staff has mandated daily sessions where players must sit in silence and stare at a bowling machine for twenty minutes. The curriculum focuses on advanced theoretical concepts such as 'how to hold a delivery' and 'the revolutionary concept of an out-swinger.'
caption: Forget the willow, it's time to reintroduce the players to the mysterious red orb! Who knew bowling was actually part of the sport? #CricketNews #CoachingLife #BCCI #IndiaCricket (satire)
igHook: Tag a friend who thinks cricket is only about watching boundaries.
imagePrompt: A close-up of a weathered leather cricket ball resting on a wooden training bench in a sunlit, empty stadium dressing room.

sourceHeadline.title: 'This is not cricket, this is only batting' - Gambhir after India's record ODI chase
